publisher: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
title_or_table: New Residential Construction, New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed, annual data, by units in structure (comps_cust.xlsx, sheet Annual)
universe_or_base: New privately owned housing units completed, by the number of units in the building
qualification: Survey-based estimates of completions; detail may not add to total because of rounding, and the latest year is revised with later releases. The stacked parts are buildings of one unit, two to four units, and five or more units

two_to_four_units_thousands.description: units in buildings of 2 to 4 units

five_or_more_units_thousands.description: units in buildings of 5 or more units

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, New Residential Construction, new privately owned housing units completed by units in structure, 1968 to 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates in thousands of units; parts may not add to totals because of rounding.
notes: (Thousands of units.  Detail may not add to total because of rounding.)
Source:  U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Survey of Construction
Additional information on the survey methodology may be found at <www.census.gov/construction/soc/methodology.html>.
